protocol.universe_selection: Same fixed 100-stock list from protocol_4h_retest.json; selected before this breakout experiment, without breakout performance
protocol.level_rule: At each 1H/4H signal bar, use only N completed daily/weekly bars strictly before its day/week; resistance=max(high), support=min(low) over those N bars. Require resistance-support>=4*ATR14 of signal bars. No current unfinished higher bar. This is a horizontal historical range, not pivot lines or chart figures.
protocol.breakout_rule: Long when signal bar closes strictly above resistance+buffer*ATR14 and previous signal close was not above that same frozen boundary; short mirror below support-buffer*ATR14. Distinct breakout events require recrossing the boundary. Ignore invalid/missing ATR or level. Signal at close, entry on next open.
protocol.retest_rule: Breakout freezes its broken level. For up breakout, within 8 later signal bars require low inside level±0.25*ATR14 and close above level; down mirror with high and close below. Reject the breakout if a later bar closes back inside the level before retest; then wait for a new breakout. Do not count a retest on the breakout bar.
protocol.exit: Opposite immediate HTF breakout event closes an existing position on next open; opposite entry may reverse. No fixed stop or forced time exit.
protocol.control: First breakout of previous 20 completed signal bars high/low, same next-open simulator and capital. Distinct from HTF level variants.
protocol.monthly_review: Full calendar months of one continuous marked-to-market account; no trade-count or positive-month threshold; show all variants and controls.
protocol.candidate_policy: REVIEW_ONLY; no automatic strategy or paper account, repeat after costs and unseen data
protocol.research_status: Exploratory follow-up to user-inspected charts and prior 4H line experiment; all historical data seen
